label: Scene Template: Logo Close
description: WHOLE-SCENE template: the closing sting. Dark and centered -- the logo blooms out of the dark, tagline, gradient CTA pill (gently pulsing), url. Use as the final scene; it never fades itself out.

logo_url.label: Logo URL (wordmark or full); defaults to the brand-kit wordmark

cta_style.label: pill (default: a gradient pill that breathes) | boxed (the ask as plain type with a hand-drawn box sketching round it -- the Scale Army close)
